summary: `automation-controller-service` (in /usr/bin) starts, stops and restarts all controller services on a node, including the message queue and the integrated database. In clustered installs it does not restart PostgreSQL; use `systemctl restart automation-controller` on each node. Do not use it in containers; restart the pod instead.
questions: How do I restart automation controller?
How do I restart controller in a cluster?
Can I use automation-controller-service in a container?

answer_card.title: Restart automation controller
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
automation-controller-service restart        # single node, includes integrated DB
systemctl restart automation-controller      # clustered: run on each node
```
External databases are managed separately. In containerized or OpenShift deployments, restart the pod instead.
